_doc: What the Tern fights with in the coop-drill (openspec/changes/coop-drill design 2.2-2.4). hull_mj and hit_radius_m are placeholders: the hull is damage-control's, and the hit test becomes the shield ellipsoid of weapons-and-shields 9. The turrets are the layout's four mounts (turret_dorsal, turret_ventral, turret_port, turret_stbd in data/ships/tern/layout.json, their centre_m here, a test holds the two together). Each arc is the placeholder for the hull mask (weapons-and-shields 3): the half of the sky its mount faces, from arc_overlap_deg below the mount's plane. Mount positions are ship-local metres. sensors: a full scan of a contact takes scan_s with Science manned (the console mockup's number) and an active ping's ring lasts ping_s.
